metadata.title: The orientation-reversing minimal stretch factor problem in small genus
metadata.abstract: We determine the minimal stretch factors among all orientation-reversing pseudo-Anosov mapping classes of the closed orientable surfaces of genus two, three and four.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 确定闭可定向 genus 二、三、四曲面上反向定向 pseudo-Anosov 映射类的最小伸长因子。
analysis.breakthrough: 补足小 genus 反向定向情形的精确极值。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。摘要非常简短，未提供数值、实现映射类或证明方法；本条不推断更高 genus 规律。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
